item.title: Explore recycling and reuse with children this National Recycling Week
item.description: Educators can explore packaging, paper and everyday waste with children during National Recycling Week running from 9–15 November. Planet Ark’s free education resources include early learning experiences that help children investigate what can be reused and what belongs in the recycling bin.

item.title: Government announces $11.5 million CCTV fund for not-for-profit early learning services
item.description: The Australian Government will establish an $11.5 million grants program to help not-for-profit early learning services install or upgrade CCTV, announced in a joint announcement from Education Ministers Jason Clare and Jess Walsh. The announcement follows a national assessment involving more than 300 services.
